overview_description.description: BukuWarung is a Y-Combinator backed technology company that is building the digital infrastructure for 60 million MSMEs in Indonesia, enabling them to efficiently manage and grow their business, starting with digital bookkeeping, online storefront & payments. BukuWarung's vision is to empower 60 million MSMEs in Indonesia to become financially aware and enable them to manage and grow their business using technology.

about_short_description.short_description: BukuWarung is a startup focused on building bookkeeping, digital payments, and e-commerce solutions for MSMEs in Indonesia.

product.name: Tagih dan Bayar (Collect and Pay)
product.description: A digital payment solution enabling MSMEs to collect payments from customers and make payments to suppliers or employees through various digital channels.

product.name: Produk Digital (PPOB)
product.description: A digital product sales platform for MSMEs to earn additional income by selling prepaid and bill payment products like mobile credit, electricity tokens, and game vouchers.

product.name: QRIS (Quick Response Code Indonesian Standard)
product.description: A unified QR code payment system allowing MSMEs to accept all non-cash payments from banks and digital wallets with same-day fund settlement.

product.name: Solusi Modal Usaha (Business Capital Solution)
product.description: A loan service offering unsecured business capital loans up to IDR 50 million with flexible repayment terms for MSMEs.

product.name: Talangin Dulu (Buy Now, Pay Later)
product.description: A pay-later payment method allowing customers to purchase stock or wholesale goods immediately and pay at a later agreed time, with funds credited instantly to the seller.

product.name: Pembukuan (Bookkeeping)
product.description: A digital bookkeeping tool for MSMEs to monitor business finances, inventory, and accounts receivable/payable efficiently and automatically.
